request-prompt: Remove the 'Sign in to like videos, comment, and subscribe' promo box from the left navigation drawer and the top right header since I do not wish to log in.
goal: I prefer to browse anonymously and passively without signing in to keep my viewing history private and uncluttered.
jobs: I want to watch long-form funny cat compilations to entertain myself.
I want to watch quick, bite-sized cat clips (Shorts) for rapid entertainment.
I want to filter my search results to only show unwatched or recently uploaded cat videos.
I want to refine my search to look for specific cat breeds, such as Siamese or Persian cats, using the suggested search terms.
I want to sign in to my account so that I can subscribe to cat-centric channels, save videos to my playlists, and leave comments.

preference-pairs.b: I prefer long-form, comprehensive videos (like full-length compilations or documentaries) that I can sit back and watch for a long time.

preference-pairs.a: I rely heavily on search filters and precise categorization to find exactly the type of video content I am in the mood for.
